verifiedSurfaceSummary: The current Angel One corporate careers page has a visible Open Positions panel. Its exact declared native renderer receives the route-owned jobs array, derives departments, filters and paginates that same input by10 and renders own /careers/{slug} links. Current ordinary browser and native source observations both show zero panel roles. Runtime binds the original unfiltered Flight model to the actual renderer, preserves native records and compares opening/closing/final arrays. This observed current UI input is not proof of upstream or whole-company vacancy absence; authoritative company totals and lifecycle cleanup remain unknown.
